articles.title: Bleachers' Jack Antonoff Declares 'This Version of Modernity Is Trash' on New Album
articles.summary: Grammy-winning musician Jack Antonoff says his new Bleachers album captures a rare moment of unity: everyone agrees modern life feels broken. He points to a surge in vinyl and moviegoing as proof we're craving analog connections.

articles.title: California Judge Bans Kars4Kids Jingle for Being 'Deceptive'—What the Ad Didn't Tell You
articles.summary: A court ruled the iconic Kars4Kids ad violates false advertising laws because it hides the charity's religious affiliation. The donor who sued felt betrayed after learning his car helped fund programs for Jewish young adults, not local kids.

articles.title: After Profound Loss, an Artist Finds Solace in a Tiny Studio and Pistachio-Loving Crows
articles.summary: Kevin Callahan's partner of 39 years died suddenly, prompting a move to Oakland. In a compact home studio, he now creates intimate 'jewel' paintings and befriends local birds—a story of resilience and reinvention.
